title: Training Schedule Update
content: New training sessions for 10m Air Pistol will start from Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM - 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM.

title: State Championship Registration
content: Registration is now open for the upcoming State Championship. Deadline: January 30, 2024. Contact academy for registration details.

title: Holiday Notice
content: Academy will remain closed on Republic Day (January 26, 2024). Regular training will resume from January 27, 2024.

title: New Equipment Arrival
content: Latest Olympic-standard air pistols and rifles have arrived. Students can now practice with professional-grade equipment.

title: Safety Protocol Reminder
content: All students must follow safety protocols strictly. Protective gear is mandatory during training sessions.
